annotations.title: Extractive English summary of news on a keyword from the last N hours

description:
Extractive English summary of news on a keyword from the last N hours. 3-5 sentence extractive summary of news matching q published in the last N hours (1-168, default 12; up to 50 items), with high_count. Use for 'what happened with X today'.

GET /news/summary/recent — price $0.007 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 12, clamped to 1-168) Default: 12.

q.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

name: summarize_recent_news
title: Extractive English summary of news on a keyword from the last N hours
